tested_scope_and_provenance.scope: Reassessed only the current executor/capability gates against the current target identity from freshly read DOWNSTREAM_STATE. Target bytes were not fetched or executed, and no Work, finite-quota, paid, browser, shell, or arbitrary-network executor was invoked.
tested_scope_and_provenance.provenance: INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST.json, RUN_LIFECYCLE.json, DESIRED_STATE.json, and DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json were read for the current authority tuple before this slice.
tested_scope_and_provenance.reproduction_evidence: none; static authority/capability inspection is not reproduction evidence

gate_decision.action: No reproduction execution performed; record truthful blocker only.
gate_decision.expected: A reproduction attempt requires a currently authorized executor with tested semantics, exact-target access, reproducibility-specific readback, and zero-Work/zero-finite-quota/zero-cost eligibility, unless explicit current policy grants a finite-quota budget.
gate_decision.observed: The current capability registry proves no such eligible executor and explicitly disallows Work and finite-quota or paid execution for this Phase-1 slice.

blocker.missing_capability: A current capability/control revision must explicitly expose an executor that is zero-Work, zero-finite-quota, zero-cost and has tested semantics, authorization/quota/billing eligibility, exact target access, and reproduction-specific readback; otherwise no execution is permitted.

continuation.next_exact_retry: On the next invocation, bootstrap the current manifest, lifecycle, desired state, and downstream state again. If the manifest/desired/downstream/capability identity is unchanged, do not reprobe the same executor path. If any relevant authority or capability identity changed, reassess the zero-Work/zero-finite-quota gate exactly once; only if an eligible no-cost executor is explicitly proven, test the exact target and record exact tool/version/input/command/query hashes, expected versus observed results, logs, and exact readback. Otherwise persist one truthful blocker record as required by the then-current lifecycle.
do_not_use: Work aliases or executors that can consume finite quota
paid execution without explicit current permission and budget
wait, poll, sleep, backoff, or retry in-run
synthetic reproduction evidence from static inspection
CLEAN exploration steering or protected O authority mutation
